name: Cislunar-Serac
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against perpetual storm systems, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
For traders, rare flora alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
